RCSP-162.description: Validate Unit Price visibility rules and UOM read-only behavior across Scheduled Orders and Order History

testCases.testName: Verify Unit Price field is removed from New Scheduled Order for store users
testCases.description: Validate that Unit Price is not displayed on the New Scheduled Order screen.

testCases.testName: Verify Unit Price field is hidden for all item categories
testCases.description: Validate that Unit Price stays hidden after adding inventory items across categories in Scheduled Orders.

testCases.testName: Verify Unit Price cannot be accessed via keyboard or DOM inspection
testCases.description: Validate that Unit Price is not reachable through keyboard navigation or present in DOM checks.

testCases.testName: Verify Unit Price field visibility matches the active role on Order History screen
testCases.description: Validate that Order History shows or hides Unit Price based on the active role.

testCases.testName: Verify Unit Price remains unavailable after adding items in Order History
testCases.description: Validate that Unit Price remains unavailable after attempting to add inventory items in Order History.

testCases.testName: Verify UOM field is read-only in New Scheduled Order
testCases.description: Validate that the UOM control remains non-editable for a Scheduled Order item.

testCases.testName: Verify UOM field is read-only in Order History
testCases.description: Validate that the UOM control remains non-editable in Order History.

testCases.testName: Verify only one purchasing UOM per item in Scheduled Orders
testCases.description: Validate that each requested Scheduled Order item exposes a single non-editable purchasing UOM.

testCases.testName: Verify only one purchasing UOM is displayed in Order History
testCases.description: Validate that Order History exposes only one non-editable purchasing UOM.

testCases.testName: Verify Unit Price visible after scheduled order is received and invoiced
testCases.description: Validate that Unit Price becomes visible after a Scheduled Order is received and invoiced.

testCases.testName: Verify Unit Price visible after Order History request is received and invoiced
testCases.description: Validate that Unit Price becomes visible in Order History after receiving and invoicing.

testCases.testName: Verify Unit Price read-only in Order History for Scheduled Orders
testCases.description: Validate that Unit Price remains visible and read-only for Scheduled Orders opened from Order History.

testCases.testName: Verify Unit Price read-only in Order History orders
testCases.description: Validate that Unit Price remains visible and read-only for Order History orders.

testCases.testName: Verify Unit Price hidden for orders not yet received
testCases.description: Validate that Unit Price remains hidden before the order is received.

testCases.testName: Verify Unit Price hidden consistency after refresh, relogin, and relaunch
testCases.description: Validate that Unit Price remains hidden after refresh, relogin, and browser relaunch.
